Messages.Author: Shawn F. Carnes
Messages.Body:
As indicated in the subject title, this is a personal message from me.
The opinions I shall state are my own and not WotC's.

First off, I refuse to answer beligerent e-mail. I am not "an
answer-boy", or "a slave to M:TG", or anything of the sort. Sorry if
some of you think I'm taking this too personally, but I am. ***Do not
send messages to my personal account, PERIOD***. I have better things
to do with my time than babysit people who need to see a chiropractor
for their serious affliction of virtual spine.

I chose to be the NetRep for this newsgroup because I care about the
game and the people that play it. Still, I don't like personal attacks
(my NetPersonality is that of a lurker, commenting only when I think it
is necessary). Sure, they're bound to happen from some people, but I
don't have to put up with them.

For those people who don't like WotC: you got a beef? Fine, but keep me
personally out of them. I will be more than happy to try and get issues
resolved for you, but I will not tolerate being a venting pillow. I
simply don't have time to be a part-time therapist. I will make
rulings, answer questions, and give VTES opinions. I will not serve as
a menuim by which some can validate their egos.

And, as for my ego, I don't have one. Just because you might disagree
with my opinion doesn't mean that I am egotistical. In this matter, I
would refer you to my comment about virtual spine.

My apologies to those who are not responsible for this outrage I
currently have. It is always a few people who ruin it for others. In
short, I am a Network Representative, not a target. Please treat me as
such, and we will have no difficulties. Thank you.

--Shawn F. Carnes

Messages.Author: Alec Chang
Messages.Body:
In article <322201...@castle.wizards.com>, sw...@castle.wizards.com
says...

>
>As indicated in the subject title, this is a personal message from me.
>The opinions I shall state are my own and not WotC's.
>
>First off, I refuse to answer beligerent e-mail. I am not "an

>(my NetPersonality is that of a lurker, commenting only when I think it
>is necessary). Sure, they're bound to happen from some people, but I
>don't have to put up with them.

No, you don't, and you shouldn't. However, 'Belligerent' may have
different meanings for different people. I, for one, hope that my post
in response to your response to Doug's comments on Ian Forestal was not
interpreted as 'belligerent'.

>For those people who don't like WotC: you got a beef? Fine, but keep me
>personally out of them. I will be more than happy to try and get issues
>resolved for you, but I will not tolerate being a venting pillow. I
>simply don't have time to be a part-time therapist. I will make
>rulings, answer questions, and give VTES opinions. I will not serve as

Who's validating their egos? Point them out so we can deflate them... ;)

>And, as for my ego, I don't have one. Just because you might disagree
>with my opinion doesn't mean that I am egotistical. In this matter, I
>would refer you to my comment about virtual spine.
>
>My apologies to those who are not responsible for this outrage I
>currently have. It is always a few people who ruin it for others. In
>short, I am a Network Representative, not a target. Please treat me as
>such, and we will have no difficulties. Thank you.

I would hope that no one on this newsgroup would treat you as a target,
Shawn. As our only means of communicating with WotC, that might cause us
a lot of problems if you got peeved at us and stopped responding...

But more seriously, I don't think that most of the people on this
newsgroup are attacking you personally. If there are any cases of this
being openly posted, I did not read them. What I have seen is commentary
on the balance of the game, which sometimes slipped into a generalized
condemnation of rules or design teams, without supporting evidence in
that particular post. The arguments have been supported at various
times.. just not in those post, and are not supportable when being
expressed in ways which seem to be over-reactions.

I, for one, am unsure If you(Shawn) interpreted my earlier post as
belligerent. If you did, then I assure you that it was not meant as a
personal attack but as a commentary upon the state of the game and
communications between players of Jyhad/V:tES and WotC. If you didn't,
please tell me so I can have my paranoia eased(it's not easy being a
malkavian....).

In any case, I hope that the discourse in this group will stay clear,
fresh, and free of name-calling or flames...and that if anyone is tempted
to break the bounds of common sense or courtesy, that they will take a
few deep breaths and a long walk to cool down before they mail or post.
Too much rides on our ability to convey our concerns to Shawn and WotC by
extension to let us make him ignore us because he thinks that we're being
unreasonable.

Alec Chang
